description: Find every place a name is used in the project, offline and without the editor: a function, signal, variable, constant, class_name, autoload, input action, group or node name, or a res:// path / uid:// (which files refer to it, and whether it exists). Looks in GDScript code (not comments), in strings where Godot looks names up (connect, emit_signal, is_action_pressed, add_to_group, get_node, load), in scene connections, node names and groups, and in project settings. Call it before you rename, move or delete anything; to make the change everywhere, use godot_rename. For engine API names use godot_api. Returns where the name is defined, then each file with the line number, the kind of use and the line itself (very common names are capped). Read-only.

name.description: what to look for, e.g. take_damage, health_changed, Player, jump, res://scenes/enemy.tscn

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

name: godot_usages
title: Find usages
